design_source.evidence: the reference builds `projector = projector or nn.Identity()` and applies the predictor to `projector(cls)`. evaluation_gap.problem: G1 screen_features and M03 score the projector output z via encoder(frames). A u->u arm never trains the projector, so every downstream evaluation would read an untrained projection and the arm would score as garbage for reasons unrelated to its world model.
